'''Blaster''' was a jury-rigged [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] created during [[Galactic War]] by [[BO-55]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] to join him in the [[Ravagers]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. Possessing both a child-like enthusiasm and advanced weaponry, BO-55 and Blaster plotted their operation to inflict maximum destruction.<ref name="Codex" /> In [[3637 BBY]] the Ravagers [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Coratanni]] dispatched them to take out the strike team send by her predecessor [[Ruugar]]. BO-55 and Blaster engaged the "dunderheads" on the deck of the ''[[Soaring Duros]]'', but were defeated after a prolonged fight.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blaster appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
